history.content: hi. not really sure why im here. just kind of a weird day i guess

idk. its like everyone my age has it figured out and im just. behind. like i missed some memo

not really left out tho. more like. im 29 and i still dont know what im doing with my life. my friends have careers, mortgages. i quit my job in march and ive just been. floundering. its embarrassing
I had that wrong, let me step back. “Embarrassing” feels closer than left out, or is there another word that fits better?

yeah embarrassed. or like. not enough? i had this whole plan to go freelance and its just not happening. and my mom keeps asking whats next and i dont have an answer and i can see her worrying and that makes it worse somehow

the exposed part is probably that i think maybe theyre right to worry. like what if i actually cant do it. what if im just not the kind of person who makes things work. i dont even know who id be if i stopped pretending i have a plan

yeah. i think i need to leave it here for now. its a lot to look at. but it helped to say it out loud i guess. thanks
